payload.description_as_reported: qualitative micro-analysis demonstrated that synchronized visual and auditory cues successfully reduced extraneous cognitive load. This cognitive optimization enabled the children to transition from silent peer mimicry to autonomous sentence construction and coherent narrative expression.
payload.pattern: Present instructional guidance as a synchronized visual-and-audio overlay directly on the primary interface element once the user has engaged with the content for {engagement_duration} seconds, rather than as a separate help panel.
